steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); localStorage.removeItem('hdb_dismissed_callouts') })()

steps.name: P6-probe-fade
steps.eval: (() => { const el=document.querySelector('.plan-screen'); const cs=el&&getComputedStyle(el); console.log('PROBE plan-screen anim', cs && cs.animationName, 'dur', cs && cs.animationDuration, 'fill', cs && cs.animationFillMode) })()

steps.name: P29-step1
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id: 'b3-sofa', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9, 3], rotation: 0, props: {} }])

steps.name: P29-type-filter
steps.eval: (() => { const el=document.querySelector('#historyPanel .cat-search input'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set; set.call(el,'add'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})) })()

steps.name: P29-probe-filtered
steps.eval: (() => { const rows=document.querySelectorAll('#historyPanel .hist-row, #historyPanel button.row, #historyPanel [style*="flex-direction: column"] > button'); console.log('PROBE filtered rows', rows.length) })()

steps.eval: (() => { const el=document.querySelector('#historyPanel .cat-search input'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set; set.call(el,'zqxjnope'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})) })()

steps.name: P39-set-prefs
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); s.setLeftMode('layers'); s.setLayersCollapsed({ livingDining: true, kitchen: false }) })()

steps.name: P39-probe-localstorage
steps.eval: (() => { const raw=localStorage.getItem('sofa.editor.v1'); if(!raw) throw new Error('sofa.editor.v1 not written'); const p=JSON.parse(raw); if(p.leftMode!=='layers') throw new Error('leftMode not persisted: '+p.leftMode); if(!p.layersCollapsed || p.layersCollapsed.livingDining!==true) throw new Error('layersCollapsed not persisted: '+JSON.stringify(p.layersCollapsed)); if(!('catalogOpen' in p)) throw new Error('catalogOpen field missing'); console.log('PROBE editorPrefs OK', JSON.stringify({ leftMode: p.leftMode, layersCollapsed: p.layersCollapsed, catalogOpen: p.catalogOpen })) })()

steps.name: P25-dismiss
steps.eval: (() => { const b=document.querySelector('.info-callout .ic-dismiss'); if(!b) throw new Error('ic-dismiss not found'); b.click() })()

steps.name: P27-open-menu
steps.eval: (() => { const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-haspopup="menu"]')]; const b=btns[0]; if(b) b.click(); console.log('PROBE menu triggers', btns.length) })()

steps.name: P27-inject-dot
steps.eval: (() => { const mi=document.querySelector('.menu-item'); const host=mi||document.querySelector('.tool-btn')||document.querySelector('.toolbar button'); if(!host) throw new Error('no host for new-dot'); host.style.position='relative'; host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',''); const dot=host.querySelector('.new-dot'); const cs=getComputedStyle(dot); console.log('PROBE new-dot host', host.className||host.tagName, 'anim', cs.animationName, 'dur', cs.animationDuration, 'bg', cs.backgroundColor) })()

steps.name: RM-probe-crossfade
steps.eval: (() => { const el=document.querySelector('.plan-screen'); const cs=el&&getComputedStyle(el); console.log('PROBE RM plan-screen opacity', cs && cs.opacity, 'animDur', cs && cs.animationDuration) })()

steps.name: RM-inject-dot
steps.eval: (() => { const mi=document.querySelector('.menu-item'); const host=mi||document.querySelector('.tool-btn')||document.querySelector('.toolbar button'); if(!host) throw new Error('no host'); host.style.position='relative'; host.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',''); const dot=host.querySelector('.new-dot'); const cs=getComputedStyle(dot); console.log('PROBE RM new-dot opacity', cs.opacity, 'bg', cs.backgroundColor, 'animIter', cs.animationIterationCount) })()
